query: Which multiple-testing and serial-correlation corrections (block/bootstrap, Newey–West, FDR, cluster-robust) are most appropriate for monthly panel event studies?

response.query: Which multiple-testing and serial-correlation corrections (block/bootstrap, Newey–West, FDR, cluster-robust) are most appropriate for monthly panel event studies?
response.answer: For monthly panel event studies, Newey–West and cluster-robust corrections are most appropriate for serial correlation and multiple testing. Bootstrap methods can also be used for inference.
